name: cited_oracle_inputs: REJECT missing required field fetched_at
notes: fetched_at is a REQUIRED field per spec Section 1.1.
Verifier MUST reject with schema_error naming the missing field.

name: cited_oracle_inputs: REJECT value_hash mismatch (integrity check)
notes: The correct value_hash for this raw_value is sha256:7c3ad7bd23c7d62f55d90ca54bcd05d832b5f58c5893f463efcbde9e436b264a.
All-zeros hash will never match a real sha256 output.
Verifier MUST recompute sha256(JCS(raw_value)) and reject on mismatch with integrity_error.

name: cited_oracle_inputs: REJECT unknown extra key (strict mode)
notes: Spec Section 1.1: no additional properties at v1. Verifier MUST reject unknown keys.
Future extension goes through ADR_005 revision (task #37), not through extra keys.

name: cited_oracle_inputs: REJECT null for optional field (null is forbidden)
expected_error_detail: cited_oracle_inputs[].feed_claimed_at must be omitted, not null
notes: Spec Section 1.3 rule 3: null is forbidden for any optional field; the field must be omitted.
This avoids canonicalization ambiguity in JCS regarding null vs absent.
Verifier MUST reject with schema_error, not silently treat null as absent.

name: cited_oracle_inputs: REJECT invalid subject_type value
notes: subject_type is a closed enum in v1: weather | ofac | time | sms_hitl | webhook | cve.
New subject types require an ADR_005 revision (task #37), not a new value in existing receipts.
Verifier MUST reject with schema_error naming the unknown subject_type.

name: cited_oracle_inputs: REJECT timestamp without milliseconds (RFC 3339 precision rule)
expected_error_detail: cited_oracle_inputs[].fetched_at must be RFC 3339 UTC with millisecond precision and trailing Z
notes: Spec Section 1.3 rule 6: all timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC with millisecond precision and trailing Z.
+00:00 offset notation is also rejected; only trailing Z is accepted.
